entries.title: A card's thread names the work your reply under it started
entries.body: When you reply under a card and your first mate starts work from it, the card's thread now gets a line saying which task it started, with a link to that task. The line shows under a card its crewmate already ended too, so you can see where your words went before you close it.

picture.alt: An ended card's thread with the line Your first mate started SCR-2 from your reply here, under the line saying its crewmate ended the card.
